request.task: Add GET /health/ready returning status ready and a non-negative integer uptime. Add an acceptance test; preserve existing routes.

operations.content:
import unittest

from app import dispatch


class ReadyEndpointTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_ready_endpoint_reports_uptime(self) -> None:
        status, body = dispatch("GET", "/health/ready")
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(body["status"], "ready")
        self.assertIsInstance(body["uptime"], int)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(body["uptime"], 0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
